newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: BESI TO SEEK BOURSE LISTING FOR PBE.
newsitem.headline: BESI TO SEEK BOURSE LISTING FOR PBE.

text.p: BE Semiconductor Industries NV said on Tuesday it was planning to seek a listing for its joint venture Possehl BESI Electronics (PBE) in about two years time.
BESI-president Richard Blickman said in a conference call he hoped to see PBE listed by 1999 at the latest and that there was a high chance the shares would be listed in Amsterdam.
"In the case of a listing it could very well be possible that we decrease our stake to 25 percent from 30 percent," he said.
BESI set up the PBE joint venture earlier this year in partnership with Germany's L. Possehl & Co and Possehl's Far East operations manager Ho Hung Tak.
The joint venture combines the leadframe stamping, etching, tooling, and plating operations of the three partners.
Earlier today, BESI announced first-half 1997 profits of 8.9 million guilders versus 23.8 million in the same period of 1996.
